text:
alex: Kicking off LON region GPU cluster boot — need a short perf + kernel sanity checklist before handoff.

maria: Nice, thanks. Can we confirm driver + CUDA matrix first? last time a mismatch killed perf.

jin: Agreed. Minimum checks:
- nvidia-smi shows GPUs healthy
- driver >= 535.x
- cuda toolkit that's used by containers matches /usr/local/cuda
- MIG profiles created if needed

sam: Also check NIC firmware & MTU. Our RDMA lanes on GCP require MTU 9000.

alex: I'll run quick commands, pasting results. Commands to run:
```
nvidia-smi
modinfo nvidia | grep vermagic
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
nvidia-bug-report.sh --logfile /tmp/bug.txt
```

maria: Add kernel module check and dmesg grep for GPU errors:
```
dmesg | egrep -i "nvrm|NVRM|GPU fault|nvidia"
lsmod | grep nvidia
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: perf-runner job queued -> job id 9876

jin: For throughput baselining use redwood-bench token generator with --seq-len 1024 and 8 concurrent streams. Expected p95 per-GPU tokens/sec baseline: 2000-3500 depending on quantization.

sam: For network: iperf3 between two instances for 60s, check single-stream and multi-stream. Expect >10Gbps single-stream for these VMs.

alex: Ran nvidia-smi — all 8 GPUs on node0 show Util 6-8% but memory used 4096MiB pinned by driver. Posting snippet:
```
# sample
| GPU | Name | Temp | Mem-Used | Util |
| 0 | A100-SXM4 | 34C | 4096MiB | 7% |
```

maria: Memory pinned by driver is ok if MIG reserved. Confirm `nvidia-smi mig -l`.

jin: Ran perf-runner job 9876, initial result attached (p95 tokens/s per GPU): [2200, 2150, 2180, 2195]. Looks within expected.

alex: Good. But we saw kernel warning about big pages:
```
[  123.456] nvidia: WARNING: failed to allocate large page size
```

maria: That's a red flag for NUMA/hugepages. Steps:
- Enable hugepages: sysctl vm.nr_hugepages=128
- Ensure kubernetes node taint for hugetlb

sam: Also run `numactl --hardware` and check CPU pinning of inference containers.

ops-bot: infra-alert: NIC firmware mismatch on lon-edge-02 (expected 14.2, got 13.9)

alex: Filed ticket #INFR-452 for NIC firmware. Will schedule rolling firmware update during maintenance window.

jin: Perf notes: when driver/CUDA mismatch occurs we see token/sec drop and kernel oops. If any p95 falls below 1700 rerun with debug flags and collect /var/log/nvidia-installer.log

maria: Handoff checklist for SRE:
- driver version pinned in golden AMI
- NIC firmware aligned
- hugepages + NUMA settings documented
- perf-runner baseline attached
- iperf3 network logs

sam: I'll add a short runbook snippet to the region provisioning playbook and tag ops on the PR.

alex: Thanks folks. Next step: I'll push artifacts to the cluster-handoff folder and ping @eng-oncall once INFR-452 is scheduled.

maria: :thumbsup:
